title: Star Trek Timelines — Character Story
tts_note: ElevenLabs eleven-v3 via fal-ai/elevenlabs/tts/eleven-v3. Each canonical character gets a dedicated voice chosen by gender and emotional register. No Chatterbox — STT always uses ElevenLabs. See characters[] for voice assignments. Long monologue (>80 words) → mandatory chunking into ≤35-word segments.

format_overrides.note: Applied from EP1 onward. Star Trek Timelines character-story = canonical Trek character narrates their own origin/lore in first person. I2V visualizes the key moments. Do NOT show the character speaking on camera — TTS is off-screen narration while Kling shows action.
format_overrides.hook_requirement: Clip 1 MUST visualize the most dramatic or emotionally charged moment of the character's arc — not a neutral opener. Visual should be scroll-stopping: crisis, loss, decisive choice. TTS line sets the stakes immediately.

era_tags.note: Do NOT write era-specific strings (TNG, TOS, DS9) in NB2/Kling prompts — the model re-assigns uniform colors. Always specify the uniform color explicitly.
era_tags.DS9: gray-shouldered command uniform, darker than TNG
era_tags.VOY: red-and-black (command) / gold-and-black (ops) — same cut as TNG
era_tags.ENT: blue-gray Starfleet jumpsuit with vertical blue/gold/red shoulder stripe

format_overrides.structure: HOOK (clip 1) → ORIGIN (clips 2–3) → TURNING POINT (clips 4–5) → REVELATION / COST (clip 6) → CTA

character_rotation.error_note: Characters listed in 'error' had a production attempt but the final video was rejected. Do NOT pick them again until manually reviewed and removed from this list.
character_rotation.selection_note: Cover all Trek eras — TOS → TNG → DS9 → VOY → ENT → DIS. Prioritize characters with strong lore arcs and tragic backstories. Alternate male/female for variety. Include complex antagonists (Lorca, Khan, Dukat) but balance with heroes. Avoid repeating characters used in dual-style / redcon within 4 episodes. 5-star characters preferred for engagement.

canonical_characters.note: Prompt blocks and Supabase refs for canonical Trek characters. Reference sheet goes to storyboarder as chain_ref. No voice_ref_url — use ElevenLabs voice name directly.

picard.name: Captain Picard
picard.voice_note: Measured, dignified, authoritative — fits Picard's philosophical command style
picard.character_description: semi-realistic bald male Starfleet captain, red and black TNG uniform with red shoulders black body, gold combadge, 4 rank pips, dignified expression

uhura.name: Nyota Uhura
uhura.voice_note: Warm, expressive, strong — fits Uhura's confidence and emotional depth
uhura.character_description: semi-realistic Black female Starfleet communications officer, red short-sleeve command dress uniform with Starfleet delta badge, elegant upswept hair, warm expressive eyes, Enterprise bridge background

janeway.name: Captain Janeway
janeway.voice_note: Sharp, determined, slight gravitas — Janeway's no-nonsense command presence
janeway.character_description: semi-realistic female Starfleet captain, reddish-brown hair in tight bun, red-and-black command uniform, decisive expression, Voyager bridge background

kirk.name: Captain Kirk
kirk.voice_note: Charismatic, bold, emotionally direct — Kirk's confident swagger
kirk.character_description: semi-realistic male Starfleet captain, athletic build, light brown hair swept to the side, confident charming smirk, gold-yellow command tunic with Starfleet delta badge, black trousers, heroic pose, dramatic bridge lighting

spock.name: Mr. Spock
spock.voice_note: Flat, precise, no emotional coloring — Vulcan logic pattern
spock.character_description: semi-realistic male Vulcan Starfleet officer, pointed ears, sharply arched eyebrows, straight black bowl-cut hair, olive-tinted skin, calm emotionless expression, blue-and-black science tunic with Starfleet delta badge

mccoy.name: Dr. Leonard McCoy
mccoy.voice_note: Warm Southern drawl, impassioned, occasionally grumpy — Bones' emotional core. Lower stability than Kirk's Daniel to differentiate
mccoy.character_description: semi-realistic male Starfleet doctor, medium build, hazel eyes, short dark hair with silver temples, blue-and-black science/medical tunic, Starfleet delta badge, slightly furrowed brow — perpetually worried expression, sickbay background with medical panels

worf.name: Commander Worf
worf.voice_note: Deep, gravelly, intense — Klingon honor in Starfleet uniform
worf.character_description: semi-realistic male Klingon Starfleet officer, prominent triangular cranial ridges on forehead, dark brown skin, long dark hair in warrior ponytail, groomed goatee, gold-and-black operations uniform, diagonal metal baldric sash, fierce honorable expression

data.name: Commander Data
data.voice_note: Flat, over-enunciated, precise — android speech pattern, no contractions
data.character_description: semi-realistic android male Starfleet officer, pale yellowish skin, slicked black hair, yellow-gold eyes, gold-and-black operations uniform, emotionless face, slight head tilt of curiosity

seven.name: Seven of Nine
seven.voice_note: Cold, clinical, detached — former Borg learning humanity. High stability, flat affect
seven.character_description: semi-realistic blonde female, hair pulled back tightly, metallic starburst Borg implant above left eye, small metallic implant on left hand, silver-and-blue form-fitting catsuit, intense blue eyes, arms crossed, Voyager astrometrics lab background

lorca.name: Captain Gabriel Lorca
lorca.voice_note: Dark, charismatic, with hidden menace — mirror-universe predator behind a Starfleet mask
lorca.character_description: semi-realistic male Starfleet captain, lean angular face, short dark hair, cold calculating eyes, black-and-metallic Discovery-era command uniform, tense predatory posture, dim Discovery bridge background with dark tones

belanna.name: B'Elanna Torres
belanna.voice_note: Fierce, passionate, quick-tempered — half-Klingon warrior fighting her own nature
belanna.character_description: semi-realistic half-Klingon female Starfleet engineer, subtle cranial ridges on forehead (less prominent than full Klingon), dark brown wavy hair, intense brown eyes, gold-and-black engineering uniform, strong jaw, defiant expression, engineering section background

carol_marcus.name: Dr. Carol Marcus
carol_marcus.voice_note: Intelligent, composed, with underlying grief — scientist's resolve
carol_marcus.character_description: semi-realistic blonde female scientist, pale blue civilian science uniform, Starfleet delta on breast pocket, clear blue eyes, hair pulled back, intelligent focused expression, science lab background with Genesis device

archer.name: Captain Jonathan Archer
archer.voice_note: Earnest, adventurous, slightly rougher than later Starfleet captains — the first great explorer
archer.character_description: semi-realistic male Starfleet captain, dark hair, brown eyes, blue-gray Enterprise-era Starfleet jumpsuit with vertical gold shoulder stripe, combadge, determined optimistic expression, early NX-01 bridge background

khan.name: Khan Noonien Singh
khan.voice_note: Theatrical, imperious, seething with controlled rage — genetic superman's arrogance
khan.character_description: semi-realistic muscular male warrior, long flowing dark hair, broad bare chest through torn red uniform, gold necklace, weathered tanned skin, intense vengeful expression, clenched jaw, desolate planet background

q.name: Q
q.voice_note: Sardonic, theatrical, omniscient amusement — the trickster god who takes nothing seriously except his own entertainment
q.character_description: semi-realistic middle-aged male in red-and-black TNG Starfleet captain uniform, smug knowing grin, theatrical raised hand, mischievous gleaming eyes, Enterprise bridge background with golden omnipotent glow distortion

borg_queen.name: Borg Queen
borg_queen.voice_note: Silky-smooth, seductive, utterly cold — the Collective speaking through one voice. High stability, zero warmth
borg_queen.character_description: semi-realistic female Borg Queen, pale grayish skin, bald head with dark biomechanical skull cap, exposed mechanical spine, black bodysuit with grey bio-tubing, dark hollow eyes, sinister knowing half-smile, Borg alcove background with green ambient glow

dukat.name: Gul Dukat
dukat.voice_note: Charming, self-righteous, delusional — villain who genuinely believes he's the hero
dukat.character_description: semi-realistic male Cardassian, gray scaly textured skin, prominent spoon-shaped cranial ridge on forehead, raised neck ridges, slicked-back dark hair, gray-brown Cardassian military uniform with armored shoulders, charming manipulative smile

episode_summaries.notes: First episode. No promo clip. Covered McCoy's Georgia origins, failed marriage, medical career driven by guilt over father's euthanasia, recruitment by Starfleet.

episode_summaries.notes: First captain of the NX-01, father's warp engine legacy, Temporal Cold War, founding of the Federation. Pioneer before the rules existed.
Mirror-universe Lorca posing as prime-universe Starfleet captain. Manipulation, betrayal, Terran Empire ambition. Dark character with no redemption arc — the monster who wore a hero's face.

episode_summaries.notes: Half-Klingon engineer torn between two cultures. Rejected by both Starfleet Academy and her Klingon heritage. Found identity through engineering genius and crew of Voyager.

episode_summaries.error_reason: Visual style inconsistency: scenes 1 and 3 rendered in 3D game style (correct), scenes 2/4/5/6/7 rendered in illustrated/painted style (different). Root cause: child-character safety filter blocked initial NB2 prompts, causing re-generation without image_urls style anchor — resulting in photorealistic output for those clips. Fix: always keep image_urls (character ref) even on safety-filter retries; rewrite prompt language only.
episode_summaries.notes: Do not publish. Redo from Phase 3 (storyboarder) with consistent style anchoring across all clips.

Title suggests omnipotence as burden, not triumph. Likely Q's origin or the moment he gained his powers — victory that became a curse. Covers Q Continuum, exile, trial of humanity, existential weight of knowing everything.
